blockers: Moon PCP is a multi-year composite at one local-time bin, not a single acquisition or same-sol time series.
Moon PCP supplies no per-bin uncertainty; the reported value is a spatial window mean.
Bolometric brightness temperature assumes unit emissivity and is not kinetic surface temperature.
No diurnal range or change rate is computed because local-time bins are not same-sol samples.
Mars THEMIS TI has no per-pixel uncertainty or QA layer; absolute accuracy is ~20%.
Mars THEMIS TI retrieval does not correct atmospheric clouds, surface slopes or subsurface ice/bedrock.
No cross-body D03 score; Earth NASA POWER context is unchanged.

mars.citation: Fergason, R.L., Christensen, P.R., Kieffer, H.H. (2006), High-resolution thermal inertia derived from the Thermal Emission Imaging System (THEMIS): Thermal model and applications, J. Geophys. Res. 111, E12004, doi:10.1029/2006JE002735
mars.coverage_test: reference coordinate inside the tile footprint and at least one native 100 m pixel within a 990 m radius
mars.nodata: no explicit no-data constant in the ISIS label; non-finite, non-positive and >10000 values rejected and counted
mars.product: USGS THEMIS-derived global thermal inertia mosaic, quantitative 32-bit
mars.tiling: ISIS3 tiled cube, 128 x 128 tiles, float32 LSB
mars.uncertainty: published absolute accuracy ~20%, relative within one image ~10%; no per-pixel uncertainty layer

moon.citation: Williams, J.-P., Greenhagen, B.T., Paige, D.A., Schorghofer, N., Sefton-Nash, E., Hayne, P.O., Lucey, P.G., Siegler, M.A., Aye, K.-M. (2019), Seasonal polar temperatures on the Moon, J. Geophys. Res. 124, 2505-2521, doi:10.1029/2019JE006028
moon.coverage_test: reference latitude within [-90, -80] and at least one native 240 m bin within a 990 m radius of the reference centre
moon.footprint: south polar cap 80-90 S, full longitude range
moon.license: NASA PDS public archive; no explicit licence field in the PDS4 label
moon.nodata: sparse bins omitted; invalid/unknown constants -9998/-9999 rejected
moon.product: LRO Diviner Polar Cumulative Products (bolometric brightness temperature)
moon.uncertainty: no per-bin uncertainty supplied by the product
moon.version: PDS4 collection 1.0 / product version 1; calibration software 4.0

scope: 18 existing Moon LOLA reference windows at two Diviner PCP local-time bins, plus 5 existing Mars Jezero CTX reference windows from one THEMIS quantitative thermal-inertia tile. Not global coverage.
